heuristics.name: Zero-Leak Airgap Audit
heuristics.rule: Execute automated regex scans across all staged files for private API tokens (Gemini, Cloudflare, Resend, Telegram, LinkedIn) prior to Git commit.
heuristics.impact: 100% clean repository audit, zero secret compromise.

heuristics.name: Astro Schema Immortality
heuristics.rule: Verify strict YAML frontmatter types and avoid redundant 'slug:' declarations that trigger Astro 5 glob-loader warnings.
heuristics.impact: Guarantees 0-error compilations across all 246+ static routes.

heuristics.name: Edge Defense & Rate Limiting
heuristics.rule: Verify Cloudflare security headers, bot fight mode, and cache-control rules to shield origins from abusive scraper crawlers.
heuristics.impact: Keeps origin bandwidth consumption minimal (56%+ edge cache hit ratio).
